plugins.releaseBodyTemplate: <% if (nextRelease.notes.length > 120000) { %>The notes of ${nextRelease.version} are longer than a GitHub release takes: read them whole in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Ploomes/qazinho/blob/${nextRelease.gitTag}/CHANGELOG.md).<% } else { %><%= nextRelease.notes %><% } %>
